name: marketnow-mcp
description: MarketNow MCP Server v1.9.0 — Agent Contract Hardening release. All 12 tools renamed to `marketnow_*` namespace prefix (snake_case + deterministic prefix) for unambiguous tool choice by Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, LangChain, and LlamaIndex agents. Tools: marketnow_search_skills, marketnow_get_skill, marketnow_list_categories, marketnow_get_manifest, marketnow_get_install_command, marketnow_verify_trust (ATC), marketnow_verify_receipt (rcpt_), marketnow_submit_skill (REAL /api/submit-skill submission with L1.5+L1.7 sync), marketnow_mint_referral, marketnow_lookup_referral, marketnow_recommend_skills, marketnow_get_owasp_compliance (OWASP MCP Cheat Sheet alignment + tool fingerprinting + capability manifest). Strict JSON-Schema (type+enum+pattern+bounds), intent-oriented descriptions, structured {content, isError} responses, INVALID_ARGUMENT/NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN_TOOL error taxonomy. ATC schema v1.1.0 (Ed25519, RFC 8032). Action-receipts for x402 + Vibe interop. Real referral tracking (5% commission). OWASP MCP Cheat Sheet compliance (12 controls, 4 live). 8,845 security-audited skills, 80 quarantined. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).
